page.overview:
What is Bugg-Shash?

Bugg-Shash is a fictional entity created by David Sutton for his short story "Demoniacal". The entity was unnamed until Brian Lumley attached a name which he had mentioned prior in "Rising with Surtsey" to the entity in "The Kiss of Bugg-Shash".

The character was later incorporated into the role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. (: Ye Booke of Monstres)

Bugg-Shash is a gelatinous creature with numerous human-like eyes and mouths covering its body. It attacks its prey by wrapping around them and drowning them in slime, often multiple people at once. Once the victims are dead they can be controlled, like puppets, to perform tasks where there is light, Bugg-Shash's only weakness.
